_comment: Executable contract for the agent attach note — the cross-device carrier of attachments in agent chats. Consumed by BOTH platforms' tests (Swift: scripts/AttachNoteContractTest.swift via scripts/test-attach-note.sh; Kotlin: android app unit test AgentAttachNoteTest). Any change to AgentAttachNote.swift / AgentAttachNote.kt must keep every case green on both sides.
